gate_off: native_MLP_output[target word token span] -= natural_gate * ((standardized pre_norm residual @ V) @ U) * output_std; FP32 delta, then BF16 cast
scope: Only L3-T2334, only input target word token span during prefill. No generated-token edits. Native attention and native MLP reconstruction remainder preserved.
threshold_rule: raw > released theta and raw > 0; gate equals raw when active, otherwise zero
probability: Sum next-token probability of literal CH/ch and one-leading-space CH/ch variants. Report at first output position and at the token overlapping the final native two-letter answer; force the identical native prefix for matched comparisons.
controls: Unhooked native; exact zero-strength hook control; no-op inactive-gate check; saved vectors for independent CPU reconstruction; hook cleanup.
limitations: Ablation of an estimated native-MLP component, without full MOLT replacement. This pilot does not establish absorption or specificity against active matched controls.
